canonicalInvariants: ApplicationDefinition is the persisted application model.
Persisted roots are exactly Resources and Workflows.
Workflow and component identity comes from object keys.
Component settings, resource references, processing, and port declarations are flat properties.
FlowMessage carries identity and correlation while FlowValue and FlowContent carry immutable reusable data.
Expected failures use normal result output; Events is diagnostic output and Completion is lifecycle state.
Semantic processing profiles hide Dataflow implementation settings.
Registration is explicit through DI and keyed services without reflection or assembly scanning.

entries.canonicalReplacement: Resources and Workflows objects with components keyed directly below each workflow and flat component properties.
currentConsumers: legacy Composition JSON and configuration loaders
uniqueBehavior: Legacy definitions allow independently named nodes, wrapped configuration, a wrapped resource map, and a separate link list.
entries.versionImpact: Major for Composition and Composition.Hosting; exact versions follow the reviewed API diff.
entries.migration: Normalize supported legacy declarations at an explicit migration boundary and persist only canonical Resources and Workflows JSON.
verification: no canonical serializer output contains legacy wrappers

entries.migration: Move remaining tests and hosts to ApplicationDefinition and revision activation before deleting the legacy DTO and runtime graph.

uniqueBehavior: Legacy construction keeps wrapped resources distinct from configuration and preserves explicit legacy Name values.
entries.migration: Move all factories to canonical ComponentDefinition contexts and use flat keyed resource references.

uniqueBehavior: The legacy host owns a standalone CompositionRuntime lifecycle separate from revision hosting.

entries.canonicalReplacement: Composition.Model.ApplicationDefinition, ApplicationAddress, ApplicationRevisionHost, ApplicationRuntimeAssembler, and stable application ports.

entries.canonicalReplacement: One internal canonical property model and one shared link declaration codec used by loading, validation, factory binding, and Designer persistence.
uniqueBehavior: Designer projection must preserve malformed declarations as raw properties while the runtime compiler reports diagnostics.

entries.canonicalReplacement: Conditional canonical links compiled once through the registered condition compiler.
uniqueBehavior: Typed direct-node predicates, separate WhenTrue and WhenFalse outputs, released Errors ports, and numeric error codes.
entries.migration: Prove false-branch and evaluation-failure migration patterns using links and normal results before removal.

entries.canonicalReplacement: Conditional links, output fan-out, and shared-input fan-in.
uniqueBehavior: Switch route envelopes and default routes expose behavior beyond basic conditional links.
entries.migration: Separate pure structural behavior from route-envelope behavior and retain a domain component only if canonical links cannot replace it.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowContentInspectNode with FlowMessage<FlowContent> input and FlowResult output.
uniqueBehavior: Per-message request options and a dedicated Errors stream.
entries.versionImpact: Major for Payloads; adapter impact follows registration review.
entries.migration: Represent required request variation through canonical input data or explicit component options and route result failures normally.

entries.canonicalReplacement: MetricsAggregateNode and EventProjectionNode using FlowResult outputs.
uniqueBehavior: Direct result types, dedicated Errors streams, and explicit final-snapshot completion helpers.
apiCompatibilityFindings: CP0001: temporary FlowMetricsAggregateNode and FlowEventProjectionNode types removed
CP0007: concise node names no longer inherit FlowNode<TInput,TDirectOutput> because Output now carries FlowResult<T>
entries.migration: Use the concise node names, inspect FlowResult status, kind, and error fields, and read the optional Value for successful or partial snapshots.
verification: SDK package validation against 4.0.0 reports only the documented intentional removals

entries.canonicalReplacement: EventExpectationNode using a FlowResult output after the canonical implementation assumes the concise name.
uniqueBehavior: Direct expectation result type, dedicated Errors stream, custom evaluator behavior, and completion semantics.
entries.versionImpact: Major for the Expectations runtime package.
entries.migration: Preserve evaluator and completion behavior, then consume expected failures as normal FlowResult values instead of an Errors port.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowContentHttpClientNode with exact FlowContent bodies and normal FlowResult outcomes.
uniqueBehavior: String and byte request fields plus decoded response text using response charset.
entries.migration: Use explicit serialization and decoding components around the exact-content HTTP node.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowContent and FlowValue FileSystem nodes plus canonical Storage content nodes with normal result output.
uniqueBehavior: Released CLR request/result contracts, typed enumeration and watch sources, and branch outputs such as Found.
entries.versionImpact: Major for affected runtime and composition packages.
entries.migration: Document canonical record shapes and normal-result routing, then migrate all typed registration tests.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowValue mapper and validator nodes with normal FlowResult output and conditional links.
uniqueBehavior: Closed generic port contracts, custom typed context factories, routed branch outputs, and dedicated Errors streams.
entries.versionImpact: Major for affected runtime and composition packages.
entries.migration: Require explicit boundary conversion between CLR values and FlowValue and replace branch outputs with conditions over result fields.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowValueAssertionNode with one normal result stream and conditional links.
uniqueBehavior: Optional routed original-input outputs and numeric AssertionErrorCodes.
entries.migration: Route canonical result kinds and explicitly retain original input where required.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowValue state reducer and FlowContent session nodes with standardized results.
uniqueBehavior: Arbitrary object state, typed session records, replay source contracts, and branch outputs.
entries.versionImpact: Major for affected runtime and composition packages.
entries.migration: Define canonical FlowValue and FlowContent record shapes and verify store round trips before removing typed contracts.

entries.canonicalReplacement: FlowValue timer and source nodes plus FlowContent serialization nodes with normal result output.
uniqueBehavior: Closed CLR output types and request-specific encoding or serialization contracts.
entries.versionImpact: Major only for packages whose public typed declarations are removed.
entries.migration: Inventory each typed declaration separately and prove value/content conversion and lifecycle parity.

entries.canonicalReplacement: Canonical FlowValue observability nodes with standardized results and Events.
uniqueBehavior: Closed generic inputs, object selectors, and direct output contracts.
entries.versionImpact: Major for Observability; composition impact follows registration review.
entries.migration: Move selectors to FlowValue semantics and replace direct outputs and Errors with normal results.

entries.canonicalReplacement: Broker resources, mqtt.client resources, MqttClientController, mqtt.control, mqtt.publish, mqtt.trigger, provider-neutral transport sessions, and adapter-owned lifecycle registration.
uniqueBehavior: Released direct publisher and trigger interfaces, adapter convenience clients, and older DI ownership defaults.
entries.versionImpact: Major for MQTT core and adapters whose public legacy APIs are removed.
entries.migration: Preserve command/result, shared-client, subscription ownership, acknowledgement correlation, reconnect, and Events semantics while moving all callers to the canonical controller facade.
